FAQ.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.desc: Know in detail about the syllabus of our data structures course, fees and scholarship

FaqDATA.ques: Under the data structures course, what learning options are offered?
FaqDATA.ans: Skillslash offers this best DSA course with project certification, and you can choose between offline and online learning options based on what fits your schedule. There's also a blended curriculum created especially for working professionals, combining live hybrid classes with hands-on practical work at the project site. Live sessions let you interact with your instructor in real time, just as you would in a typical face-to-face class, and all practical work is carried out through cloud-based services.

FaqDATA.ques: If I have to skip a lesson because of an emergency, would there be a make-up session?
FaqDATA.ans: This course is delivered through live online classes, and recordings of every session are provided to all students. You get unrestricted access to these recordings, so you can refer back to them whenever you need to revisit a concept. That said, we'd still strongly encourage attending the live classes wherever possible.

FaqDATA.ques: What if I didn't fully comprehend a module? Will I be able to take the data structures course again?
FaqDATA.ans: Yes - you can retake that module with a different batch at no extra cost if you didn't fully grasp it the first time. This way, there's no chance of moving ahead while still confused about the material.

FaqDATA.ques: What is Skillslash’s data structures course scholarship program?
FaqDATA.ans: Under this scholarship program, every candidate takes a 20-minute online aptitude exam. Candidates who score above 65 percent are eligible for a 10 percent discount on the course fees, while candidates between jobs and mothers looking to restart their careers can receive up to a 100% scholarship based on their exam score.

FaqDATA.ques: What kind of certification does this best Data Structures Course provide?
FaqDATA.ans: By enrolling in this course, you'll receive practical training experience, and you can also avail shareable, globally acknowledged project certifications directly from top startups - meaning you get certifications from the companies you're associated with for live projects.
